description: Lists the playlists an account has published on its profile. Same visibility rules as jj_list_profile_songs. `songCount` already counts only what the caller is allowed to see: a published playlist hides the songs its author did not publish.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's `nextCursor`. Replay it verbatim.

handle.description: Public username of the account, with or without the leading "@".

name: jj_list_profile_playlists
title: List playlists published by an account
